verdict.rationale: Anytype documents some first-party control over where data is kept and whether it is removed. Local-only mode disables Anytype's backup node so data stays on the device, content is stored locally, and the API can delete files in spaces. It does not document configurable retention periods, account or vault deletion, or deletion of data already held on backup nodes. A community report also notes there is no option to set the local storage path. Missing for 10: retention policy/period controls, documented account or vault deletion, server-side backup purge guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
